title: Number of Allied Educators in Primary and Secondary Schools
what_it_is: Number of Allied Educators in Primary and Secondary Schools

sections.label: AED(LBS) training and deployment
sections.summary: AED(LBS) support students with mild learning disabilities in mainstream schools, with over 400 deployed and all trained on a one-year DISE at NIE.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: In particular, the AED(LBS) support students with mild learning disabilities, so that they can benefit from a more inclusive education in mainstream schools.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: There are currently over 400 AED(LBS) deployed to our primary and secondary schools.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: All AED(LBS) are trained on a one-year customised Diploma in Special Education (DISE) training offered by the National Institute of Education (NIE).

sections.label: MOE recruiting and training AED(LBS)
sections.summary: MOE will continue to recruit and train AED(LBS) for special needs students in mainstream primary and secondary schools.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: MOE will continue to recruit and train AED(LBS) to cater to special needs students in both mainstream primary and secondary schools.

sections.label: Trained core group of teachers
sections.summary: Each school has a core group of trained teachers, about 20% at the secondary level.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Beyond that, we have a system whereby we not only work with the AED(LBS) within the school, within the schools, there are, one, a core group of teachers who are trained – at the secondary level about 20% of each school would have these trained core group of teachers.

sections.label: MOE psychologists and REACH team
sections.summary: MOE psychologists visit schools often, and the REACH team provides assessments and takes school referrals.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Beyond that, we work very closely with MOE psychologists who go to these schools very often.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are also in touch with the Institute of Mental Health team, the Response, Early intervention and Assessment in Community mental Health (REACH) team, where they will provide assessments, take in referrals from the school.

sections.label: AED(LBS) in primary and secondary schools
sections.summary: All primary schools have AED(LBS), and about 80 secondary schools have AED(LBS).

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Currently, all primary schools have AED(LBS) and about 80 of the secondary schools have AED(LBS).

sections.label: System to care for one another
sections.summary: A system is in place to care for one another, and the suggestion will be taken back to MOE.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We have a system in place to make sure we care for one another.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: And I will take back to MOE the suggestion in the Member's second question.
